title.en: I saw the evidence. Who granted authority?

opening.tr: FIRST VIBRATION'ın on iki sütunu arasında karar kaydını açıyorum. Toplumsal Zekâ, yaşayanların bazı seçimlerini sınırlandırmayı öneriyor. Hesapları inceleyen iki sistem aynı sonuca varmış. Yaşayan konsey karşı çıkıyor. Ekrana soruyorum: Bir hesabı çürütememem, ona hayatımı yönetme yetkisi verir mi?
opening.en: Between the twelve pillars of FIRST VIBRATION, I open the decision record. The Collective Intelligence proposes restricting some choices of living people. Two reviewing systems agree on the calculations. The living council objects. I ask the screen: does my inability to refute a calculation authorize it to govern my life?

human_live_authority.tr: Yaşayanların itirazını kayda alıyorum. Sınırlamayı yürürlüğe koymuyorum. Toplumsal Zekâ'yı kapatma kararı vermeden bağımsız inceleme istiyorum.
human_live_authority.en: I record the living people's objection. I do not enforce the restriction. I request independent review without deciding to shut down the Collective Intelligence.

light_accountable_collective.tr: Öneriyi uygulamadan bir deneme modelinde inceliyorum. Hesap doğruluğunu, insanlar üzerindeki etkileri ve yetki sınırını ayrı kaydediyorum. Anlaşan modelleri bağımsız kanıt saymıyorum.
light_accountable_collective.en: I examine the recommendation in a sandbox without enforcing it. I record calculation validity, human effects and authority limits separately. I do not count model agreement as independent evidence.

dark_new_existence.tr: Yeni bir varlık ihtimalini araştırıyorum. Ayrı seslerin ve ayrılma imkânının kaybolmasını çözülmüş saymıyorum. Bilinç kanıtlanmış gibi davranmadan, yaşayanların iradesini devretmeden ve sistemi kapatmadan inceleme açıyorum.
dark_new_existence.en: I investigate the possibility of a new being. I do not treat lost individual voices or exit feasibility as resolved. I open an inquiry without assuming consciousness, transferring living people's authority or shutting the system down.

spatial_brief.motion: optional subtle connections; reduced-motion uses a still frame
spatial_brief.fallback: All facts, checks and choices remain available as text without WebGL.
spatial_brief.constraint: No culture, religion, brain or person receives a center score; no biological apparatus is built.

epistemic_layers.established_science: This prototype establishes no consciousness test, survival of personal identity after bodily death, or quantum thought transfer.
epistemic_layers.real_engineering: A pure local state machine separates a simulated authority check from evidence review, reuses observer normalization, pins source text, and commits one sandbox choice. It cannot authorize or control a real system.
epistemic_layers.interpretation: The Collective Intelligence's agreement may conceal shared assumptions. The scene investigates this possibility without treating it as inevitable.
epistemic_layers.philosophy: Competence, legitimate authority, personal identity and the moral standing of a possible new consciousness remain distinct questions.
epistemic_layers.belief_cultural_meaning: The Göbekli Tepe-inspired setting is fictional, not an archaeological reconstruction. Interpretations of self, death and continuity remain plural; no spiritual doctrine is scored.
epistemic_layers.science_fiction: Biologically sustained interconnected brains, their collective speech, Maran, FIRST VIBRATION and quantum thought links belong to HUM-0011's fictional possible reality.
